name: rosetta-sorting-algorithms-comb-sort
code:
use default

comb_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    let gap mut = values.count
    let sorted mut = false

    while !sorted do
        gap = cast int(cast double(gap) / 1.3)

        if gap <= 1 then
            gap = 1
            sorted = true
        fi

        for i in 0..values.count - gap do
            if values[i] > values[i + gap] then
                (values[i], values[i + gap]) = (values[i + gap], values[i])

                sorted = false
            fi
        od
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

comb_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))

let words = LIST(["pear", "apple", "quince", "banana"])

comb_sort(words)

write_line(words |> join(", "))
